en.purpose: To calculate the total score for the NTISS
en.use: Use to record the therapeutic interventions received by a newborn during a 24-hour scoring period
en.misuse: Not to be used outside the neonatal intensive care population.

other_details.en: The NTISS Score (Neonatal Therapeutic Intervention Scoring System) is a severity-of-illness index for neonatal intensive care.

gt0001.description: The NTISS Score (Neonatal Therapeutic Intervention Scoring System) is a severity-of-illness index for neonatal intensive care, derived by modifying the Therapeutic Intervention Scoring System (TISS), that quantifies the intensity and complexity of therapeutic interventions a newborn receives during a defined scoring period.
